paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.

model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the Expert Win Rate, expressed as a percentage, for various large language models alongside an overall average. The vertical value axis is labeled "Expert Win Rate (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal gridlines appearing at regular intervals of 20 units. The horizontal category axis lacks an overarching title but displays the names of the models as diagonally rotated labels. The bars are not sorted alphabetically or by ascending or descending values, though the first category, "Average," is visually emphasized on the horizontal axis with bold, dark red text. The chart consists of 13 vertical bars, each rendered in a distinct solid color and annotated with its exact numeric value directly on top. From left to right, the bars represent the "Average" in dark gray (88.89), "GPT-4o" in sage green (84.38), "GPT-4-turbo" in slate blue (91.67), "GPT-4o-mini" in steel blue (97.56), "Claude 3 Opus" in mauve (83.12), "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" in grayish blue (88.46), "Claude 3.5 Haiku" in tan (86.25), "Gemini 1.5 Pro" in light blue (87.04), "Llama-3.1-405B" in pale lavender (97.14), "Mistral Large" in light beige (91.14), "DeepSeek-V3" in light gray (82.26), "Qwen-Max" in pale cream (85.07), and "GLM-4-Plus" in pale pink (92.54). The lowest value shown is the DeepSeek-V3 bar at 82.26, while the tallest bar is GPT-4o-mini at 97.56. Vertical gridlines also span the background between the category columns.
